description: This file defines a Polymer web component 'paper-ripple' that provides a visual ripple effect for material design interactions. It includes HTML template, CSS styles, and JavaScript logic for ripple animation, event handling, and customization options.

classes.name: ElementMetrics
classes.description: Helper class to compute and store element dimensions and furthest corner distance for ripple calculations.

classes.name: Ripple
classes.description: Class representing individual ripple animations, handling drawing, interaction states, and animation logic.

methods.name: addRipple
methods.description: Creates a new Ripple instance, appends its DOM, and starts animation.

methods.name: removeRipple
methods.description: Removes a specified ripple from DOM and internal list.

methods.name: animate
methods.description: Performs animation frame updates for all ripples and manages the animation lifecycle.

methods.name: simulatedRipple
methods.description: Triggers a ripple effect programmatically, simulating a user interaction.
